annotations.description: Playing Cavern of Souls on turn 1 is suboptimal because it only produces colorless mana or one color for a chosen creature type. The hand has Bringer of the Last Gift (Vampire Demon) and Superior Spider-Man (Spider Human Hero) — these share no creature type, so Cavern can only help cast one of them. More importantly, Starting Town enters untapped on turns 1-3 and produces any color of mana (at 1 life cost), making it ideal for later turns when you need flexible colored mana. Playing Starting Town now while it's free to enter untapped, and saving Cavern of Souls for later when you know which creature type to name, would be better sequencing.
